page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 16 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 8 physical cores with two threads per core. The instance provides 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. It does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes for persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results reveal an emphasis on parallel throughput rather than single-threaded processing speed. The Intel Xeon 8163 architecture scores in the bottom 10% on Geekbench single-core tests (926.0) and exhibits weak single-core stress-ng metrics (1106.28), alongside poor single-threaded compression performance. Conversely, multi-core metrics settle squarely in the middle 50%, with a PassMark CPU score of 12976.5, Geekbench multi-core score of 5680.0, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieving 52.96 GB/sec. Uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidth benchmarks reach 74.18 GB/sec and 58.83 GB/sec respectively.

Regarding operational characteristics, the instance is cost-efficient for applications requiring significant memory allocations without needing bleeding-edge single-threaded compute performance. The trade-off centers on conservative per-core execution speeds and the absence of bundled local NVMe storage, meaning I/O-intensive workloads rely on external storage pipes over the 3 Gbps baseline network interface. Database operations and in-memory key-value stores perform consistently, logging 11.68 million Redis SET operations per second and average PassMark database ratings.

The ecs.u0.c1m8.4xlarge instance is aligned with memory-heavy workloads, including in-memory databases like Redis, mid-tier relational database management systems, static web serving infrastructure, and concurrent data caching layers. Its low single-thread IPC and absence of hardware acceleration make it poorly matched for intensive mathematical modeling or larger-scale machine learning inference, as demonstrated by weak 7B model token generation rates.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, paired with an extensive 128.0 GB of memory for an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio. The server lacks bundled local storage and GPU acceleration, while provisioning a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks demonstrate modest single-threaded performance offset by reliable multi-core throughput, logging a multi-core Geekbench score of 5680.0 and 11.68 million Redis SET operations per second. With large memory capacity relative to compute capacity, it offers qualitative resource efficiency for memory-intensive operations. The instance is suitable for in-memory caching systems, distributed key-value datastores, relational databases, and static web serving.
